item.objective: Bind exact-commit GitHub Actions workflow enumeration to an explicit, response-confirmed REST API version and authenticated execution envelope.
completed_slices: Reviewed current GitHub primary documentation for REST API versioning, workflow-run filtering, authentication, provider ceilings, and pagination.

Implemented a fail-closed execution-envelope validator requiring exact endpoint binding, explicit API version, response confirmation, authenticated Actions-read permission, rate-limit headers, byte-record digest, and absence of deprecation or sunset headers.
Added six deterministic tests covering valid evidence, unversioned requests, response-version mismatch, deprecation/sunset, provider-ceiling ambiguity, and missing Actions-read permission.
Recorded source status, evidence strength, uncertainty, design implication, and falsification route in a retained evidence artifact.
acceptance_remaining: Capture real authenticated response headers and records for one exact commit in the private repository.
Verify whether x-github-api-version-selected is present in the live response and preserve the observed header set.
Integrate the validator before R-020/R-021 reconciliation and retained V-001 bundle promotion.
Retain the raw Link-header pagination chain and reject coverage if the filtered result reaches the documented 1000-result ceiling.
item.safe_next_action: Run the version-pinned exact-commit request with an authenticated Actions-read token, retain headers and records without credentials, validate the execution envelope, then pass only verified output into the existing dual-enumeration reconciliation path.

handoff.reason: V-001 already consumes R-020/R-021 enumeration artifacts; this gate prevents an unversioned or closing API contract from being treated as promotion-quality evidence.
